source.name: Overgrow
source.originalDescription: When HP is 30% or less; increase all damage dealt by 20%. When HP is low, increases all damage dealt.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Overgrow は 与ダメージを変化させる、HP割合条件で発動する。

damageFormula.trueDescription: When HP is 30% or less; increase all damage dealt by 20%.

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, becoming a vine whip that strikes twice, pulls enemies between both vines, and stuns them for 0.4s, then applies a 20% slow for 1.5s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also pulls enemies inward between the vines.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、相手を引き寄せる、移動速度を下げる、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Seed Bomb
source.originalDescription: Venusaur hurls a large seed to the designated location, damaging all enemies in the radius. Hurl a large seed at the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Seed Bomb には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

damageFormula.label: Damage
damageFormula.trueDescription: Venusaur hurls a large seed to the designated location, damaging all enemies in the radius.

baseAction.notes: 直接ダメージと単純移動はbaseActionへ保存し、特殊効果件数には含めない。

source.name: Razor Leaf
source.originalDescription: Venusaur launches a barrage of sharp-edged leaves in the designated direction, damaging enemies 10 times over 0.75s. Launch many sharp-edged leaves in a quick succession of attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

source.name: Verdant Anger
source.originalDescription: Venusaur becomes unstoppable to hurl a massive seed to the designated location, damaging all enemies in the radius and slowing them by 35% for 1s. The seed then splits apart into 4 smaller seeds, each damaging all enemies in their radius. Launches a giant seed toward the designated area. The seed then splits apart, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Verdant Anger は 移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する。
